name: EtsyAds Skill Lite
focus: Etsy 站內廣告選品、整店預算、Listing 檢查與成效閱讀
english: Offline Etsy onsite Ads listing readiness, shop-level budget scenarios and report analysis.

onsite_ads: 檢查主圖、標題、標籤、商品需求與可配送國家
核對每筆訂單成本、售價與库存
選擇可測試商品並規劃整店日預算
將 SKU 分攤視為內部會計，不是 Etsy 的商品出價
閱讀廣告報表，將 Offsite Ads 分開

notes: Etsy Ads is onsite CPC advertising. Offsite Ads has a different scope and fee model and is excluded.
Do not invent manual keyword bidding, negative-keyword controls or per-listing budgets.
A listing-level strategy may depend on account features; this v1 does not model that control.
An attributed order can contain an item different from the clicked listing; do not assign its profit using a clicked SKU margin.
checklist: 主圖、標題、標籤與商品內容一致
可配送區域與預期買家一致
整店日預算不等於各 Listing 出價
廣告成交與自然／Offsite 成交要分開

sources.title: Set up and manage Etsy Ads
sources.summary: Choose listings and a daily budget; charges accrue for clicks. Availability is account-dependent.

sources.title: Review Etsy Ads performance
sources.summary: Review costs and attributed results; listing quality and attribution context matter.
